resources.string: Take back your time. Find your peace. Become your best self.

SoulSpace uses this accessibility service solely to detect when restricted applications are opened and display a mindful pause screen, helping you overcome smartphone distractions. No personal data, keystrokes, or screen contents are collected or transmitted.
Daily habit, water, and timetable notifications
Status of active app blocking sessions and focus modes
Ambient soundscapes and meditation audio controls
